roleContext.jobDescription: The retail banking complaints team investigates and resolves customer complaints within the regulator's time limits. candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Complaints Handler, Retail Banking Complaints

## Experience

- Complaints handler in a retail bank's complaints team for three years, investigating about four hundred complaints a year against the account records under the team's investigation procedure.
- Handled the phone conversations on each case, including the escalated calls the branch network passed to the team; the quality checkers' call monitoring scored my calls within the call standard in every quarter of the three years, with the scorecards in the quality folder.
- Wrote the final response letters under the team's letter standard, with ninety-six per cent issued within the regulator's time limit over the period.
- Agreed redress within my delegated limit and referred the cases above it to the team leader, recording the referral and the limit on each case.
- Wrote the open items note and the hand-over conditions on each case passed to another handler or to the quality checkers.

## Work samples

- Work sample: two anonymised case files (investigation notes, call log with the quality scorecard, final response letter, redress record) and the quarterly call monitoring scorecards, with the complaints system references as a verification trail.
